title: The Exact System That Won Anthropic's Hackathon Now Free
description:
The winner of the Anthropic Hackathon just open sourced his full Claude Code setup. It's called Everything Claude Code and it has 181 skills, 47 sub-agents, and 79 commands. One skill scans security, another optimizes memory, a third learns from your past sessions. Works in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, and Gemini. The author used this exact claude code setup and ai automation system to build a full startup in 8 hours and win the Grand Prize. The best free claude code tutorial resource available right now.
Get the repo here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1pJyNNu_ojKM3p_SZRRhSoQwAsz9VWY8R/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=110897400342351178452&rtpof=true&sd=true
